guideline: Annotators were asked to choose which of two sentences (generated vs. Oxford) better illustrates the target word, based on overall quality. For each example, annotations were collected from 2 different annotators and only examples with inter-annotator agreement were kept. The order of sentences was randomly flipped and the source of each sentence was hidden from annotators.
